meta.source: Salesforce Data Cloud Platform Services Rate Sheet (Nov 2025)

items.label: Internal Data Pipeline
items.description: Rows moved between Data Cloud objects internally. Included at no charge.
items.usageNote: Free. Included (0 credits) for both Batch and Streaming per the rate sheet.

items.label: (External) Data Pipeline - Batch
items.description: Rows ingested from external systems via batch connectors (SFTP, S3, Snowflake, etc.).
items.usageNote: Batch column of the (External) Data Pipeline row.

items.label: (External) Data Pipeline - Streaming
items.description: Rows ingested via real-time streaming connectors (Kafka, webhooks, event APIs).
items.usageNote: Streaming column of the (External) Data Pipeline row.

items.label: Data Transforms - Batch
items.description: Rows transformed via scheduled batch data prep and Data Transforms.
items.usageNote: Batch column of the Data Transforms row.

items.label: Data Transforms - Streaming
items.description: Rows transformed in real-time via streaming Data Transforms.
items.usageNote: Streaming column of the Data Transforms row.

items.label: Unstructured Data Processed
items.description: Unstructured content (PDFs, text, images) chunked and vectorized for AI use cases.
items.usageNote: Applies to Search Index and unstructured data lakes for Einstein / Agentforce.

items.label: Intelligent Processing
items.description: AI-driven intelligent processing of data (semantic enrichment, entity extraction, etc.).
items.usageNote: Was missing from earlier UI versions due to a leading space in the PDF source.

items.label: Data Federation or Sharing Rows Accessed
items.description: Zero-copy rows federated / shared from Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, etc.
items.usageNote: No storage cost - data stays in source warehouse; charged per row accessed.

items.label: Data Share Rows Shared (Data Out)
items.description: Rows shared out of Data Cloud to external consumers via Data Share.
items.usageNote: Applies to zero-copy sharing to Snowflake / BigQuery / Databricks recipients.

items.label: Private Connect Data Processed
items.description: Data moved over Private Connect (AWS PrivateLink) instead of the public internet.
items.usageNote: Applies to secure private network egress/ingress via Private Connect.

items.label: Profile Unification
items.description: Identity resolution runs that unify individual profiles across sources.
items.usageNote: Charged each time the identity resolution ruleset is executed.

items.label: Sub-second Real-Time Events
items.unit: Per 1 Million combined Events, API & Actions
items.description: End-to-end sub-second events, API calls, and actions flowing through Data Cloud.
items.processingRateNote: Per 1 Million combined Events, API & Actions
items.usageNote: Combined meter across Events, API, and Actions - highest-value real-time use case.

items.label: Calculated Insights - Batch
items.description: Rows processed by scheduled Calculated Insights (batch metric aggregations).
items.usageNote: Batch column of the Calculated Insights row.

items.label: Calculated Insights - Streaming
items.description: Rows processed by real-time streaming Calculated Insights.
items.usageNote: Streaming column of the Calculated Insights row.

items.label: Inferences
items.description: Predictive or generative AI inferences executed on Data Cloud data.
items.usageNote: Applies to classical ML predictions and generative model calls scored on DMOs.

items.label: Data Queries
items.description: Ad-hoc query API rows returned to Marketing Cloud, MC Personalization, Sales/Service, etc.
items.usageNote: Charged per row returned across Query API, SQL, and Personalization retrievals.

items.label: Streaming Actions (including Lookups)
items.description: Real-time Data Actions (including Lookups) triggered from Data Cloud.
items.usageNote: Data Action Targets and Lookup actions - one credit event per action.

items.label: Segment Rows Processed
items.description: Rows evaluated when a segment or attribute filter is published.
items.usageNote: Charged per segment publish job over the underlying population.

items.label: Batch Activation (with or without related attributes)
items.description: Rows activated to batch destinations (Marketing Cloud lists, Ads audiences, SFTP files).
items.usageNote: Very low rate - designed for high-volume batch audience delivery.

items.label: Activate DMO - Streaming
items.description: Rows activated to real-time destinations via DMO streaming activation.
items.usageNote: Higher rate reflects real-time activation infrastructure.

items.label: Code Extension
items.description: Custom code extensions running on Data Cloud infrastructure.
items.usageNote: Charged per compute unit consumed by custom code.
